raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 3, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the record holder by confusing the Overseas BBC Sports Personality of the Year with the main award, incorrectly claiming Muhammad Ali (3) had the most wins. This misinterpretation of the search results led the process toward the wrong person and thus the wrong brother initially.
